style: Photorealistic travel photograph, shot on a full-frame mirrorless camera, natural true-to-life colors, realistic soft light, high detail, vertical composition. No people, no text, no letters, no logos, no signs with writing

items.name: 1-steps
items.prompt: A long old mossy stone stairway climbing a forested mountainside in Takao, Kyoto, through a tunnel of red and orange Japanese maple trees, scattered red leaves on the stone steps, soft morning sunlight filtering through the leaves, gentle haze, a wooden temple gate far up the steps

items.name: 2-canopy
items.prompt: Looking up into a canopy of Japanese maple leaves glowing red, orange and gold, backlit by soft sunlight, thin dark branches, blue sky peeking through, natural colors

items.name: 3-leaves
items.prompt: Close-up of fallen red and orange maple leaves on old mossy stone steps, a few leaves resting on green moss, soft side light, shallow depth of field

items.name: 4-wall
items.prompt: Old stone retaining walls covered in moss along a long stone stairway at a mountain temple in Kyoto, red maple branches arching over, dappled sunlight

items.name: 5-kondo
items.prompt: A large old wooden Japanese Buddhist main hall with a grey tiled hip-and-gable roof and dark wooden pillars, standing at the top of a wide stone stairway on a mountain, red maple branches in the foreground, clear autumn sky

items.name: 6-valley
items.prompt: View from a mountain temple terrace down into a deep forested gorge in Kyoto covered in red, orange and yellow autumn leaves mixed with green cedars, a clear river far below, soft afternoon light
